Method of Attack: Creating fake COVID-19 vaccination certificates by hacking into the National Health Service of Ukraine (NHSU) information system and entering false vaccination data
Selling a fake 'Action' app clone on Telegram to generate fake vaccination certificates, driver's licenses, and student cards
Impacted Systems: National Health Service of Ukraine (NHSU) information system
Attack Vector: Illegal infiltration/hacking of NHSU information system
Distribution of fake 'Action' app via Telegram channels
Indicators of Compromise: False vaccination entries in NHSU database
Fake 'Action' app sold on Telegram for 120 hryvnias ($4.5)
Modified health records up to 200 times a month
Use of false QR code vaccination certificates
